# Assess 6: Plan of Action and Milestones (A-6)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | Assess (A), system level |
| Phases | Engineering and Manufacturing Development (PH-EMD) (primary) |
| Depends on | Assess 5: Remediation Actions (A-5) |
| Inputs | Security assessment report (ART-SAR), System risk assessment (ART-RA), Organizational risk context (ART-ORG-CONTEXT), STIG/SRG summary (ART-STIG), System Security Plan (ART-SSP) |
| Outputs | Plan of action and milestones (ART-POAM), produces |
| Writes facts | — |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: PM/SO (PER-PM), CCP (PER-CCP), ISSM (PER-ISSM) · A: PM/SO (PER-PM) · C: IO (PER-IO), Privacy (PER-PRIV), Component CISO (PER-CISO), SCA (PER-SCA), MDA (PER-MDA), ISSO (PER-ISSO) · I: AO (PER-AO) · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |
| Persona cards | [PM/SO (PER-PM)](../../personas/PER-PM.md), [CCP (PER-CCP)](../../personas/PER-CCP.md), [ISSM (PER-ISSM)](../../personas/PER-ISSM.md), [IO (PER-IO)](../../personas/PER-IO.md), [Privacy (PER-PRIV)](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md), [Component CISO (PER-CISO)](../../personas/PER-CISO.md), [SCA (PER-SCA)](../../personas/PER-SCA.md), [MDA (PER-MDA)](../../personas/PER-MDA.md), [ISSO (PER-ISSO)](../../personas/PER-ISSO.md) |

Purpose: Prepare the POA&M for every open finding from the assessment report and every open CAT I STIG finding.
<!-- END rmf:header -->
<!-- rmf:body authored -->

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** A-3 is done, and A-4 and A-5 are done or deferred
   (`uv run rmf status <run>`). Why: the POA&M plans the remediation of what the assessment
   left open.
2. **List the weaknesses.** From `artifacts/sar/results/*.yaml`, every finding with
   `status: open` that A-5 did not triage `inconsequential`; from `artifacts/data/stig-summary.yaml`, every finding with
   `status: open`.
3. **Decide which need an item:**
   - every open SAR finding (SAR-POAM-001);
   - every open CAT I STIG finding (STIG-002);
   - every open CAT II or CAT III STIG finding, unless an item for the same control and
     weakness already exists; then name the STIG finding in that item's `comments`.
   Why: DoD tracks every unremediated weakness in the POA&M (DoDI 8510.01 Table 5, A-6);
   one weakness gets one item.
4. **Interview** PER-PM, then PER-ISSM (`## Interviews`) for the remediation plan, resources,
   dates and milestones of each item; PER-CCP when an item falls on an inherited part.
5. **Write `artifacts/poam/items.yaml`** whole from `templates/data/poam-items.yaml`, one
   item per weakness:
   - `id`: `POAM-###`, numbered from `POAM-001`.
   - `finding_ref`: the `FND-###` or `STG-###` it remediates; `control_id`: that finding's
     control; `source_of_weakness`: `sar` or `stig`.
   - `weakness` (one line) and `description` (what is wrong and its effect).
   - `severity`: the finding's severity (SP 800-30 scale; for a STIG finding, CAT I →
     `high`, CAT II → `moderate`, CAT III → `low` unless the assessor rated it).
   - `residual_risk`: the risk while the item is open, after mitigations in place.
   - `risk_level`: the risk assessment level, the RAR's once a risk links the item (R-3 keeps
     them equal, ASMT-009); `criticality` of the deficiency; `mitigation_approach`.
   - `identified`: `event`, `reviewing_organization`, `date`.
   - `status`: `planned`, or `ongoing` once work has started. Use `delayed` with `comments` and
     `obstacles` (not funding) when a date slips, `completed` only with the finding resolved,
     `completed_on` and a `corrective_action_test`, `risk-accepted` (this tool's extension) once the AO accepts it (ASMT-011).
   - `priority`: a unique rank across the items, a higher risk first unless the lower
     risk's deficiency is more critical (ASMT-012). Rank the RAR's
     risks the same way at R-3. Use the order the organization's POA&M process in
     ART-ORG-CONTEXT sets, within risk level. Why: the prioritized approach is uniform.
   - `point_of_contact`: the persona who owns the fix; `resources_required`: people, money
     or releases needed.
   - `scheduled_completion` and `milestones` (`description`, `due`), dated after
     `run.yaml:as_of` and consistent with the organization's remediation period in
     ART-ORG-CONTEXT or with the PM's justification for a later date.
   - `recommended_completion`: `before-authorization` or `after-authorization`; an item
     recommended before authorization is scheduled on or before the decision (MPOA-001).
   - `sources`: the finding's artifact (`ART-SAR` or `ART-STIG`) and the answers.
   `rmf build` freezes each item's `scheduled_completion` and `milestones` after A-6's
   CHECKPOINT in `artifacts/poam/original-dates.yaml`; those dates never change again. A
   missed milestone keeps its date: add `milestone_changes` (`milestone`, `new_date`, `reason`)
   and set `completed` on a milestone when it is met (ASMT-010).
   All of severity, point of contact, resources, scheduled completion and milestones are
   required for every item (POAM-FLD-001, enforced in a later phase; write them now).
   Once a decision is in the ledger the file also holds `ao_review` (`by: PER-AO`, `reviewed`,
   `agreed: true`): the AO reviews the POA&M to agree the remediation actions, at R-3 or R-4
   (MPOA-001).
6. **Write `artifacts/ART-POAM.md`** from `templates/artifacts/ART-POAM.md`: how items were
   derived, remediation approach and resourcing, items that exceed the organizational
   remediation period and why, each section traced. Name items by ID (`POAM-###`); the
   records live in `items.yaml`.
7. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task A-6`,
   until 0 errors. SAR-POAM-001 fails if an open finding has no item.
8. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT.

## Interviews

| Persona | Why | Question focus |
|---|---|---|
| PER-PM | accountable (A); oversees POA&M development and resources (DoDI 8510.01 §4.4.b(5)(g)) | fix and release plan per weakness, funding, dates, interim mitigations |
| PER-ISSM | responsible (R) | milestones, points of contact, tracking and reporting |
| PER-CCP (when applicable) | responsible (R) for inherited weaknesses | provider fix and date |

At least 1 interview; this playbook expects PER-PM and PER-ISSM interviews.

## Inputs

- `artifacts/ART-SAR.md`, `artifacts/sar/results/*.yaml`
- `artifacts/ART-STIG.md`, `artifacts/data/stig-summary.yaml`
- `artifacts/ART-RA.md`
- `artifacts/ART-ORG-CONTEXT.md` (remediation period, POA&M process)

## Outputs

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/poam/items.yaml` | — | schema `poam-items` |
| `artifacts/ART-POAM.md` | `artifact_id: ART-POAM`, `produced_by_task: A-6`, `touched_by: [A-6]` | |

## Facts

A-6 writes no facts.

## Done when

- Every open SAR finding and every open CAT I STIG finding has a POA&M item, and every item
  has the DoD-required fields.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task A-6` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task A-6`, with the item count by severity.
